scope_alignment: Frontend only supports creating, updating, recording, listing, and inspecting end-to-end validation runs for the fixed streaming progress endpoint, strictly using the authoritative API contract.

pages.title: Validation Runs
pages.purpose: View recent end-to-end validation runs for the streaming progress endpoint, filter by key metadata, and navigate to detailed inspection.

data_requirements.name: test_runs
data_requirements.description: Recent validation runs with latest outcome metadata.

api_consumption.usage: Initial page load and filter refresh.

user_actions.action: Filter runs by start date range
user_actions.details: Applies started_at_gte and/or started_at_lte query parameters.

loading_states: Initial skeleton table/cards while GET /test-runs is in progress.
Inline loading indicator when filters are changed and list is refreshing.

error_states.ui_response: Show filter-level error message indicating invalid status, date, or limit input and preserve current inputs for correction.
Show full-page or inline retry state with last attempted filters.

empty_states: No test runs returned: show empty list message and CTA to create a new run.
No results for current filters: show clear-filters option.

pages.title: Create Validation Run
pages.purpose: Register a new queued validation run before or at test start.

data_requirements.name: new_test_run_form
data_requirements.description: User-entered metadata required to create a test run.

user_actions.details: Capture endpoint path, method, start time, optional environment, initiator, run name, and optional expected summary values.
POST body must include status='queued', started_at, endpoint_path, endpoint_method.

user_actions.action: After success, navigate to run detail

loading_states: Disable submit button and show in-progress state during POST /test-runs.

error_states.ui_response: Show field and/or form errors for missing required values, unsupported fields, invalid method, or non-queued status.
Show retryable form-level error without losing entered values.

pages.title: Validation Run Detail
pages.purpose: Inspect one validation run, view ordered event history, and support manual lifecycle/event recording during an end-to-end test.

data_requirements.name: test_run_metadata
data_requirements.description: Core run metadata and latest persisted summary.

data_requirements.name: ordered_progress_events
data_requirements.description: Ordered progress event stream for the run.

api_consumption.usage: Manually update lifecycle state or final outcome details.
Manually append observed streamed event during testing.
Optional optimization for a single-call detail hydration instead of separate metadata + events calls.

user_actions.details: Manual refresh because no streaming/subscription endpoint exists in the API contract.
PATCH status=passed with optional completed_at and summary.observed_final_state/pass_reason.
PATCH status=failed with optional completed_at and summary.observed_final_state/failure_reason.
Record observed event with required sequence_number and event_timestamp; optional payload and validation details.

loading_states: Page-level loading while run metadata and events are fetched.
Section-level loading when only events are refreshing.
Inline submit spinners for status update and event append forms.

error_states.case: Invalid or malformed run id (400 INVALID_ID on GET)
error_states.ui_response: Show invalid run identifier message and link back to run list.

error_states.case: Run not found (404 NOT_FOUND on metadata/full fetch)
error_states.ui_response: Show not found state with navigation back to run list.
Show validation errors on status form.

error_states.case: Run not found on status patch (404 NOT_FOUND)
error_states.ui_response: Show stale record warning and prompt to return to list.
Show retryable error within event stream section while preserving loaded metadata if available.

empty_states: No progress events recorded yet: show empty event stream message and manual append event CTA.

pages.title: Run Inspection Summary
pages.purpose: Review computed event-derived summary metrics and quickly inspect terminal or anomalous events for one run.

data_requirements.name: run_metadata
data_requirements.description: Basic run identity/context for page header.

data_requirements.name: anomalous_or_terminal_events
data_requirements.description: Filtered set of terminal and anomalous events.

user_actions.action: Use anomalies list to identify issues for manual status update on detail page
user_actions.navigation: Contextual return to detail page; no direct anomaly resolution endpoint exists.

loading_states: Page-level loading while all inspection resources are fetched.

error_states.case: Run not found for metadata (404 NOT_FOUND)
No events found for summary computation (404 NOT_FOUND from summary endpoint)
error_states.ui_response: Show no-event summary state; still allow anomalies request result rendering if available and link to detail page to append events.
Show partial-content tolerant error banners per section.

empty_states: No anomalous or terminal events returned: show clean-run message.
No events available yet for summary: show guidance to record or ingest events from detail page.

shared_components.purpose: Consistent title, breadcrumbs, and primary actions.
Collect filter criteria for run listing.
Display pageless list of recent runs using returned items only; no pagination assumptions because contract exposes only limit.
Visual status indicator for queued/running/passed/failed/cancelled.
Compact rendering of summary fields available on list rows.
Form wrapper for create run inputs aligned to createTestRun request schema.
PATCH status submission form limited to allowed fields.
POST progress event form limited to appendProgressEvent schema.
Structured display of run metadata and persisted summary fields.
Ordered event display with optional raw payload expansion.
Read-only rendering of raw_payload objects.
Display computed event-derived metrics from summary endpoint.
Highlight terminal event details from computed summary.
Display terminal/anomalous event subset with validation flags.
Render event validation booleans and notes.
Reusable no-data state.
Reusable page-level error state.
Reusable section-level error message.
Skeleton state for list/table areas.
Skeleton state for detail/inspection panels.

frontend_constraints: No frontend feature should imply backend test execution because the API contract has no endpoint to start or orchestrate a test against the streaming endpoint beyond creating a run record.
No live auto-stream UI contract should assume SSE/WebSocket support; refresh must be manual or client-timed polling implemented against existing GET endpoints only.
No delete UI for runs or events should be offered because no delete endpoints exist.
No event edit UI should be offered because events are append-only in the API contract.
No full run edit UI should be offered; only lifecycle/status updates via PATCH /test-runs/{test_run_id}/status are supported.
No cross-run analytics dashboard beyond list filtering should be offered because the contract provides no aggregate analytics endpoints.
Pagination beyond a simple limit control should not be assumed because the list endpoint exposes limit but no cursor/page metadata.
